name: 19802 · Wilmington, DE
findings: ZIP 19802 (Wilmington) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19802 (Wilmington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19802 (Wilmington) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
